problem.explanation: The join supplies product names while GROUP BY creates one revenue total per product. Multiplication happens per item before SUM. A common mistake is summing unit_price without quantity. LEFT JOIN plus COALESCE would be needed if unordered products must appear with zero.
hints: Join product names to their order items.
SUM(quantity * unit_price) per product and use a name tie-breaker.
problem.reference_solution: SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY revenue DESC, p.name
problem.statement_markdown: Return each ordered product name and its revenue, calculated as quantity multiplied by unit_price across order items. Sort revenue descending, then name.
problem.title: Total revenue by product
